title: Get the password of the Wi-Fi network
summary: Use the `wifi-password` command to retrieve the password for the Wi-Fi network you are currently connected to, or for a specific network by its name.
prerequisites: The `wifi-password` tool must be installed (e.g., via Homebrew).

steps.explain: Run the command to display the password for the currently connected Wi-Fi network.
steps.expect: The SSID and password of the current Wi-Fi network are printed to the terminal.

steps.explain: If you need the password for a different network you have connected to before, specify its SSID.

placeholders.name: SSID
placeholders.description: The name of the Wi-Fi network.

steps.expect: The password for the specified network is printed.

steps.explain: To get only the password string without the network name, use the quiet flag.
steps.expect: Only the password string is printed to the terminal.
